description: Primary Operational Metering is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This Dataset contain time series data taken from Northern Powergrid's analogue sensors located at Primary substations. The data is part of a series of releases under an Energy Networks Association Open Networks initiative aimed at enabling interested parties to gain a greater insight into the Utilisation of the distribution network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Transformer, Demand, High Voltage (HV), Methodology. The portal shows 2022-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
